scientific_integrity: Direct proof from cited asymptotic curvature functionals and Hölder duality. Symbolic Taylor moments and standalone standard-library quadrature provide independent reproducibility routes. No finite computation is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Leading normalized expected-error coefficients for fixed positive continuous boundary densities only; no finite-sample minimax claim or universal sixth-order gap. A near-circular planar support-function family has the sharp computed sixth-order correction. Historical priority is provisionally assessed, and full independent audit was not performed.
title: Exact minimax compromise for circumscribed random polytopes and a sixth-order sharp separation
